name: PUBH 5431
title: Public Health Research Methods
description: Introduction to conceptualization, methods, and analysis in public health research including: formulation of research questions and hypotheses, development of research and analytic models, use of qualitative (interviewing and observation) and quantitative (seconday and survey data) data collection methods, and qualitative and quantitative data analysis leading to the formulation of research projects.
requirement_description: Open only to Master of Public Health (MPH) students; others with department consent.
